policies.context: Non-interactive system accounts (nobody, daemon, ftp) must not have interactive login shells (/bin/bash, /bin/sh). Must be set to /sbin/nologin or /bin/false.
SSH server configurations must disallow Protocol 1, legacy Arcfour/DES ciphers, and weak MD5/96-bit MACs.
policies.remediation: Enforce Protocol 2, AES-GCM, and SHA-2 MACs in /etc/ssh/sshd_config

policies.context: Audit log files must have world-writable and world-readable permissions removed (chmod 0600) with centralized syslog forwarding.
